observed_bottleneck: Parent n-c555e44c6daf gives every non-padding recurrent state equal weight in its normalized 512-dimensional sequence embedding, so ubiquitous boundary and syntax positions contribute as much to GP distance as rarer atom, bond, ring, and stereochemical positions. Its downstream mechanics are operational across three seeds—all 450 surrogate fits are positive definite and assimilate every observation—but disposable optimization still lowers paired posterior-mean reward in 130 of 435 rounds and has pooled sitagliptin_mpo lift of only 0.00011006466612005493. Representation-only sibling n-d3657d86652a shows that this frozen geometry is consequential: removing one corpus-estimated length axis raises mean paired macro score by 0.02482218848232635, yet regresses seed 2 and the median_2 and zaleplon_mpo task means, so deleting a whole global coordinate can also discard useful chemistry. Node n-f851988d522a instead lowers in-table graph-equivalent disagreement by repeating labeled views but lowers seed-0 macro score by 0.15944257826084401 and weakens expected-improvement lift. The limiting behavior addressed here is therefore indiscriminate uniform pooling inside the offline single-view representation, not failed assimilation or a need to duplicate scored graphs.
hypothesis: Replace uniform recurrent-state mean pooling only in the frozen sequence representation with bounded corpus-IDF-weighted pooling, so states at tokens that occur in fewer unlabeled corpus molecules contribute more to the normalized embedding while the autoregressive policy itself remains unchanged.
method_thesis: Pretrain a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES model and its sequence representation only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, retain a frozen prior, and restart all task-local state for each independent objective. Fit a probabilistic surrogate only to the ten fixed scored molecules and subsequent oracle-evaluated molecules, while maintaining an oracle-anchor policy updated only from returned true scores. Before each evaluator-announced batch, clone that anchor into a disposable inner policy, optimize the clone without oracle calls using the surrogate posterior mean as its molecular reward, and ancestrally sample a fresh ephemeral set of complete SMILES from the resulting policy. Canonicalize locally, remove invalid, previously evaluated, and duplicate molecules, and select the requested number by greedy batch expected improvement; after feedback, refit the surrogate, update the oracle anchor from the real observations, and discard the inner clone. Thus every submitted molecule is generated de novo, the corpus is never scored or searched as a candidate pool, and surrogate feedback changes the source distribution itself before acquisition rather than merely ranking proposals from a fixed generator. The optimization target is solely the equal-weight mean of the five independent terminal Top-1 scores.
